transcript: Speaker A: I work with my team all day in English. Then, I talk trash to my brother in Spanish. Watch how Flow keeps me sounding human in both. Or brought in some contract help? See, Flow cleaned it up, but kept my constructive tone. I sound like a teammate, not like AI wrote a performance review. My brother's delusional. You are completely wrong. The Lakers are never going to win the championship with that roster. They need to make big changes or they will keep losing.] Warm and helpful in English, unfiltered trash talk in Spanish. Flow sounds like me, not like ChatGPT. And nobody has to listen to a voice note. Flow works in 100 languages! Get it free today.
on_screen_text: Wispr Flow. Try for free. Android, iOS, Mac, Windows. Various text overlays showing the transcribed messages in English and Spanish.
summary: The presenter demonstrates Wispr Flow, an AI dictation tool that transcribes speech into polished text while preserving natural tone. He showcases its versatility by dictating a professional English email and a casual Spanish text message. The ad concludes with a call to action to download the app for free.
